rapport_notes: Very warm, handled an address-correction detour smoothly, closed with a genuine explanation of the Meet Your Mover email and website.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we're hourly based. So at the end of the day you will only pay for the actual time... if you're able to stage the boxes near the door... that really helps you save time" — beats-it-pay-less plus self-prep tip.

top_strength: Closed with a full, specific Meet Your Mover delivery — "our system will send you the meet your mover email... to introduce the name of the movers... go to the north Dallas section so you can see their faces" — plus a near-verbatim close ask ("would you like us to help you with the new [move]?").
coaching_note: No damage-coverage/on-time-guarantee content and no fairness check — pair the strong Meet Your Mover moment with the $2,000 coverage line for a complete takeaway.
